source: local warehouse/curated/facts, current Iceberg snapshot (NOT the serving database)
scope: tracked CIKs (data/targets/tracked_ciks.csv), us-gaap, catalog duration tags, qtrs=4, fiscal_period=FY, is_original

queries.original_fy_rows_by_form: select form, count(*) from f where taxonomy='us-gaap' and qtrs=4 and fiscal_period='FY' and is_original and tag in (select tag from t) and cik in (select cik from trk) group by 1 order by 2 desc
queries.keys_with_no_annual_form_row: select count(*) from (select cik,tag,fiscal_year from f where taxonomy='us-gaap' and qtrs=4 and fiscal_period='FY' and is_original and tag in (select tag from t) and cik in (select cik from trk) group by all having not bool_or((form like '10-K%' or form like '20-F%' or form like '40-F%')))
queries.keys_with_only_10q_rows: select count(*) from (select cik,tag,fiscal_year from f where taxonomy='us-gaap' and qtrs=4 and fiscal_period='FY' and is_original and tag in (select tag from t) and cik in (select cik from trk) group by all having bool_and(form like '10-Q%'))
queries.keys_with_both_10q_and_10k_rows: select count(*) from (select cik,tag,fiscal_year from f where taxonomy='us-gaap' and qtrs=4 and fiscal_period='FY' and is_original and tag in (select tag from t) and cik in (select cik from trk) group by all having bool_or(form like '10-Q%') and bool_or(form like '10-K%'))
